newsitem.title: POLAND: EBRD to decide on Polish BGZ stake or loan by June.
newsitem.headline: EBRD to decide on Polish BGZ stake or loan by June.

text.p: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) will decide by June if it will give a loan or buy a stake in Poland's cooperative Bank Gospodarki Zywnosciowej SA (BGZ), BGZ's president said.
"By June the EBRD will decide on the size and form of boosting BGZ's capital," Kazmierz Olesiak told a news conference on Thursday.

He said BGZ, which is the so-called national bank for the country's 1,200 cooperative banks grouped in nine regional banks, needed the cash to introduce a single computer system for the whole structure.

Last year, the finance ministry said it was holding talks with the EBRD on selling it between 10 and 20 percent of BGZ, the government holds 63 percent. The remaining stock belongs to the cooperative banks.
BGZ's gross profit in 1996 rose 37.1 percent to 495.4 million zlotys. Its capital eased 6.3 percent to 1.502 billion zlotys and its gross balance sheet rose 20 percent to 13.952 billion zlotys.
